title: Decision workbook: where the reference model fails, specialists and the flag

text.finding: Inside IMPROVE, with TOR as the truth and whole sites held out, the reference model (spline, k = 4) under-predicts the filters most like Addis: heavy loading by 33 % and low OC/BC by 30 % of mean TOR, against +13 % on the rest (§3). A per-filter local calibration on raw spectra (each filter's 500 nearest IMPROVE spectra) cuts RMSE on every hard group (-25 to -46 %) and on ordinary filters too (-23 %), so it is a candidate for option A rather than a specialist rule (§4); its Addis readout is on Experimental → Loading-matched analogs. Applied to every SPARTAN filter, the flag (+ HIPS) is highest at Addis (mean 0.79) and Dhaka (0.59); the spectrum-only flag, which does not read HIPS, points weakly the same way as the FTIR–HIPS intercept across site-seasons (§6).
